name: Glass Pavilion, Toledo Museum of Art (2006, SANAA), 2445 Monroe St
refs: No usable open-licence photo; built from published descriptions (SANAA/Front Inc./Pilkington/Domus/Bluffton College) + LiDAR footprint and height.
notes: One-storey pavilion ~60 x 60 m, roof ~4.5 m: continuous floor-to-ceiling low-iron curved glass perimeter with no exposed mullions, a thin aluminium fascia over the roof edge and a low aluminium platform at the base.
